exposure: multimorbidity (two or more chronic disease diagnoses)
cohort: The study cohort included 14,225 livebirths and stillbirths at Grady Memorial Hospital from October 2015 to April 2021.
finding: Individuals entering pregnancy with two or more chronic diseases were at an increased risk of severe maternal morbidity and postpartum readmission compared with individuals with one or zero chronic disease diagnoses.
